title: Browse Microdata Catalogs Using NADA REST API
text: nadaverse gives researchers, policy analysts, data enthusiasts streamlined, programmatic access collections global microdata. Many national international organizations—including World Bank, IHSN, FAO, UNHCR, , national statistics offices—use National Data Archive (NADA) software manage disseminate survey census data. catalogs rich sources information, interacting often requires tedious manual browsing complex API construction. nadaverse cuts complexity. provides unified, reliable, user-friendly interface search, filter, retrieve crucial metadata documentation (file lists data dictionaries) directly R environment.

Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (kenya): Get available collections. kenya_collections <- collections("kenya")  # 6. United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (unhcr): Get available collections. unhcr_collections <- collections("unhcr")  # 7. The World Bank (wb): Get supported country codes. wb_countries <- country_codes("wb")  # 8. World Health Organization HIS (who): Get available access codes. who_codes <- access_codes("who")  # 9. Zambia Statistics Agency (zambia): Get latest entries (limit 10). zambia_latest <- latest_entries("zambia", limit = 10)  # Example for the metadata function (requires a study ID) wb_study_metadata <- metadata("wb", id = 8098) str(wb_study_metadata) }

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
text: Performs comprehensive search specified catalog's API endpoint, utilizing full range available searching, filtering, sorting parameters.

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
code: search_catalog(   catalog,   keyword = NULL,   from = NULL,   to = NULL,   country = NULL,   inc_iso = NULL,   collection = NULL,   created = NULL,   dtype = NULL,   sort_by = NULL,   sort_order = NULL,   ps = NULL,   page = NULL,   rows = TRUE )

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
text: catalog required character string specifying name data catalog (e.g., "fao", "wb"). Valid codes listed catalogs(). keyword character string used search data titles, descriptions, keywords (e.g., "lsms"). integer indicating start year data collection's coverage period (e.g., 2000). integer indicating end year data collection's coverage period (e.g., 2010). country character vector. Provide one country names ISO 3 codes (case-insensitive). valid codes, see country_codes(). Multiple values passed vector, e.g., c("afg", "Indonesia", "bra"). inc_iso logical value. TRUE, results data frame include ISO3 country codes; otherwise, contain country names. Default: NULL. collection character vector. Filters results data collection repository ID, returned repo_id column collections(). Multiple IDs can searched passing vector. created character string used filter results date creation update within catalog. Use date format YYYY/MM/DD. Single date: "2020/04/01" (returns records created date). Date range: "2020/04/01-2020/04/20" (returns records within range). dtype character vector. Filters results one data access types. Valid values include: "open", "direct", "public", "licensed", "enclave", "remote", "". See access_codes() list available types catalog. Example: c("open", "licensed"). sort_by character string used specify column sort results. Valid values : "rank", "title", "nation" (country), "year". Note "country" automatically mapped API field "nation". sort_order character string indicating sort direction. Must either "asc" (ascending) "desc" (descending). ps integer indicating number records display per page results. Default: 15 records. page integer specifying page number search results return. rows logical value. TRUE, function returns data frame matching studies. FALSE, returns full result list, adds search information (found, total, limit offset) rows data frame. Default: TRUE.

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
text: rows = TRUE (default), data frame row study matching search criteria. rows = FALSE, list number studies found (found), catalog total (total), page size offset (limit, offset), rows data frame. nothing matches, warning issued NULL returned. Network failures, HTTP errors non-JSON replies raise error.

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
text: function constructs complex API query based provided arguments (keywords, temporal range, geography, access types) returns matching data entries. function automatically handles URL encoding JSON parsing. parameters correspond directly search options available NADA (National Data Archive) platform used organizations like World Bank FAO.

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
text: Gutama Girja Urago

title: Search Catalogs — search_catalog
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() # Example 1: Basic search for a keyword in the World Bank catalog wb_search <- search_catalog(   catalog = "wb",   keyword = "LSMS",   ps = 5, # 5 records per page   page = 1 ) head(wb_search)  # Example 2: Search by country and year range fao_search <- search_catalog(   catalog = "fao",   country = c("Kenya", "UGA"),   from = 2010,   to = 2020,   sort_by = "year",   sort_order = "desc" )  # Example 3: Filter by access type and get search information wb_info <- search_catalog(   catalog = "wb",   keyword = "labor",   dtype = "public",   rows = FALSE ) print(wb_info$found) # Check total number of records found  # Example 4: Include ISO codes in results ihsn_results <- search_catalog(   catalog = "ihsn",   inc_iso = TRUE ) head(ihsn_results) }
